description: Use this for the market overview: which collections trade most, have the lowest or highest ask, or the most listings, with the lowest ask in Stars, TON and USD, the number of Telegram listings and MRKT plus Portals sales and TON volume in the last 24 hours, plus the 24h and 7d change of the lowest ask (from the stored floor change log; null when a collection had no ask then). Do not use it for one named collection (get_collection).
name: top_collections

change_24h_percent.description: Percent change of the lowest ask over 24 hours, from the stored floor change log; null when there was no ask then. See change_basis / caveat.

change_7d_percent.description: Percent change of the lowest ask over 7 days, from the stored floor change log; null when there was no ask then. See change_basis / caveat.

title: Top gift collections
